source.text: Hygiene gleich null. Morgens um acht, die Brötchen Auslage voll mot Haaren. Der Mülleimer neben dem Ausgang ist voll. Der Boden verklebt. Es gibt keinen Rewe den ich kenne, der so eklig, versifft und schmutzig ist. Geht selbst hin und schaut es selbst an.
source.textTranslated: Hygiene is nonexistent. At eight in the morning, the bread display was full of hair. The trash can by the exit was overflowing. The floor was sticky. I don't know of any other Rewe supermarket that's so disgusting, filthy, and disgusting. Go and see for yourselves.

claims.text: the bread display was full of hair
the trash can by the exit was overflowing
other Rewe supermarkets are not so disgusting

reference.notes: The venue is a supermarket; the hair on the Brötchen display is food_hygiene, while the bin and floor are general cleanliness / dining_area. The 'worst Rewe I know' comparison reads as a cleanliness opinion but could be a verdict; the closing 'see for yourselves' is a sarcastic warning, taken as a negative verdict.
